record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, change each NextItNet block's residual update from residual+y to residual+0.5*y. Fixed residual scaling may limit amplification of noisy convolutional updates across six blocks while retaining causal context processing. Preserve all input features, embeddings, convolution dimensions and dilations, final-real-position readout, scoring, loss and optimizer; apply the identical formula in prediction.

category_rationales.rationale: Scale each causal convolution block's residual update by 0.5 to reduce amplification across six blocks in all four category models. The generated predictor imports this same model class, so training and inference remain consistent without changing checkpoint shapes, features, readout, scoring, loss or optimizer.
